Business Overview:
[1]
[2]
BCPLRIL), based in West Bengal, is a contractor for the Indian Railways specializing in overhead equipment (OHE) contracting. Its operations cover the complete cycle of designing, drawing, supply, erection, and commissioning of 25KV, 50Hz single‑phase traction overhead equipment, supporting railway infrastructure development and modernization projects.
The company provides turnkey solutions
for setting up traction substations that
regulate electrical current for energizing locomotives. In addition, it offers modification services for existing electrified tracks, enabling them to support Indian Railways’ high‑speed expansion plans.
